rules.title: Posting rules
rules.intro: usmfomo puts upcoming USM club and school events in one place. These rules keep it useful and safe for everyone, and apply to every post.

who.title: Who can post
items: Clubs: student-run bodies, including societies, Desasiswa committees and the Student Representative Council (MPP).
Schools: academic and administrative units, including schools, centres, institutes and HEPA units.
Each club or school gets one account, set up by the usmfomo admin. Students never need an account to browse.

allowed.title: What you may post
items: Real USM events that your club or school organises.
Accurate details: the event name, date and time, venue and a clear description. Edit or cancel the post if anything changes.
Honest links: a link must go where it says, such as your registration form or official page.

notAllowed.title: What's not allowed
items: Hate speech or harassment of any person or group.
Sexually explicit content.
Political party content or campaigning.
Alcohol or gambling.
Other people's personal data, such as phone numbers, IC numbers, addresses or photos shared without consent.

limits.title: Limits
items: Up to {{live}} live posts at a time.
Up to {{daily}} new posts in any 24 hours. Deleting a post doesn't give the slot back.
Up to {{edits}} edits in any 24 hours.
An event can last up to {{days}} days. Posts disappear by themselves when the event ends.
Posters: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to {{mb}} MB. They are shrunk automatically before upload.

posters.title: Poster tips
items: Keep the important part in the centre: event lists show a square crop from the middle.
Use large text. Most students will see your poster on a phone.
Put the date, time and venue in the post as well, not only on the poster.

security.title: Keep your account safe
items: Turn on two-step verification (2FA) in Studio settings. It's optional, but strongly recommended.
Each committee member adds their own phone, so the account isn't lost when one person leaves.
Never share the password outside your committee. When the committee changes, ask the usmfomo admin for a handover.

moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.body: The usmfomo admin may hide or remove any post that breaks these rules, and may pause an account that keeps breaking them.

account.title: Getting an account or a new password
account.body: There is no sign-up: accounts are created by the usmfomo admin. To ask for an account, a new password or a 2FA reset, <contact>message the usmfomo admin</contact> from your club's or school's official account, so we can check that it's really you.

disclaimer.title: An unofficial project
disclaimer.body: usmfomo is an independent, unofficial student project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by Universiti Sains Malaysia. Events are posted by the clubs and schools themselves.
